items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: The interviewee mentions Dodds in the context of sound quality ('effects that that dodds and and bichet used') and recounts stories about Dodds involving other musicians (Natty, Sidney, Jimmy Noon), but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Dodds himself.

ctx.x: the albert system. You really noticed it you are you pretty sure I mean that it isn't just your imagination or something? No no I'm sure of it. inflexible yeah i wonder if other players will tell us that they don't even can't even tell the difference some of the fellows here that play um albert they'll say well they could never tell the difference they just picked it up because it's the cheapest thing they could get maybe but i always thought myself maybe there's really a difference yeah i think there is because of the larger bore incidentally i'll put this little story on too i don't want to take up all the time talking but we don't have this up there…
